Name: Novaroma Season Icons
Author: JestingDart4369
Description: 27,546 icons for your keys in five seasonal colour themes (Default, Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter), each in light, dark and burgundy, with a tile background or without any background (file names end in -clear). 120 classic symbols plus a library of 387 toggle symbols, each as an outline Off and a filled On version for two-state keys: lights (spot light, built-in downlight, cupboard and under-cabinet light, LED strip, key light, ring light, lamps), media, devices, files, arrows, shapes and numbers. Made with the help of AI (Claude by Anthropic) and reviewed by the author.
